title: WE REMOVED THEM FROM SCHOOL!
description:
After the girls school sent home a very vaguely worded letter regarding higher than normal levels of the radioactive gas Radon detected in an area of the school. We took the decision to remove our girls from school in the short term. Until we can get proper reassurance and guidance on the severity of the situation with Radon gas at their school. Radon is a very high health hazard in certain higher doses over time and can cause devastating illnesses such as lung cancer. So to minimise the level of health risk to our children in the short term while we investigate what is happening we removed them from the school. This was not a decision we took lightly at all. So please no hate on our decision on this video. We are working closely with the school and the City Councils Health and Safety board to investigate and move forward with this issue so it is resolved as soon as possible.
